conditions.expression: Target is authenticated Born in Bloom player standing on green ground; final Races owner installed; jem_world_boss_tiers optional module present

change.summary: Registered bosses retain native targeting against Bloom rather than becoming passive on ordinary green ground.

modifiers.before: Cancel every mob target toward Bloom on green except EnderMan, including every registered boss.
modifiers.after: Preserve cancellation for ordinary mobs; do not cancel for any mob with a canonical WorldTierApi.profile. No boss allowlist or independent encounter state.

cause.owner: Final Races SandboxRaceTraits and optional ProductionRaceBridge

rationale.purpose: Prevent mandatory boss fights losing their targeting simply because a Bloom participant stands on grass.
rationale.decision_source: User2026-10-20 Power System Revamp requests race/boss interaction fixes, coherent progression and no trivialized mandatory bosses.
rationale.user_requested: Preserve working racial abilities and correct combat exploits through server authority.
rationale.codex_choices: Exempt only canonical registered boss profiles through installed optional API; native targeting, start/participant gates and all V/B mechanics remain their existing owners.

introduced.summary: Query canonical WorldTierApi.profile on the existing optional bridge; registered bosses retain native target selection against Bloom players on green ground. Ordinary mob passive preserved.

history.summary: Query canonical WorldTierApi.profile on the existing optional bridge; registered bosses retain native target selection against Bloom players on green ground. Ordinary mob passive preserved.

relations: Registered boss keeps hosted encounter target validation rather than race passive canceling it
notes: Optional module absent returns false before reflective API resolution; present but incompatible API fails visibly using existing bridge error contract. No hard optional class linkage or mirrored profile state.
JemRoles constructor disables legacy RaceTraitRuntime when final jem_visual_sandbox installed; inactive legacy-only target path remains unchanged.

Offline regression executes actual unchanged target handler and bridge methods with minimal entity/registry/module boundaries; registered and dynamically unregistered profiles, ordinary green/barren targets, absent optional API, Void kin and Nether piglin passive checked.
unresolved: Real native boss AI/target event interactions in equipped solo/co-op runtime remain unrun.
Roles-only distribution without final Races retains legacy passive behavior; current managed distribution uses final owner.
